The infinite assertion rests on mathematical proof, not finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: For the natural infinite family of circular-ladder 3-colouring reconfiguration graphs, the result measures both the sizes and numbers of allowable moves of every topological sector, beyond known yes/no reachability. It gives the full quantitative connected-component structure, an infinite-period frozen-state exception, and exact integer formulas useful for local-state-space analyses. This is neither a routine unmotivated single finite case nor a cosmetic reformulation of the chromatic polynomial.
